runtime: PGlite PostgreSQL; mocked auth.uid/Auth table and Storage bucket metadata only

results.name: Migration executes on a fresh PostgreSQL database
Seed is repeatable and creates only draft catalog/content
Auth bootstrap ignores self-assigned role metadata
Duplicate product/blog slugs and invalid foreign keys rejected
Production limits must be positive and complete allocation is required
Money, coupon values and variant-product consistency are constrained
Public catalog is readable; draft products and their images/variants are private
Published blog and sections readable; scheduled content remains private
Customers can edit only their own profile and addresses
Review ownership, validation and moderation cannot be bypassed
Normal clients cannot self-assign roles or modify operational inventory/orders
Protected admin role grants catalog access but not role assignment
Order items/address are immutable snapshots; private order reads enforced
100th sale permanently archives; no restock, reuse, deletion or run expansion
Admin-configured 250 and 1000 runs archive at their own limit, never at 100
Every application table has RLS and Storage buckets remain private
